notes: for that renders מֵאֲשֶׁר and by reason of renders the עַל of עַל־הַנָּפֶשׁ; reading by reason of as the מִן's compound preposition was the competing division and was rejected because the two phrases stand in that order in the English.
In בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא both articles are unrepresented and the demonstrative pronoun takes that same, since a morpheme standing in the phrase is itself what the determiner renders (rule 41's limit).
